properties.description: Later MVP work, after the current component-check review experience is usable: expose earlier runs in the shared Repositories result details, scoped to the selected check or test. Keep run history out of the repository discovery bush. Build on the latest-result model and presentation, retaining run/source identity and freshness. Agree the history interaction with the user before implementing it. This is part of Repositories, not a return to a separate Checks navigation view.
properties.title: Add check result history to repository details
